minutes.headline: Select Board ratified building inspector, DPW assistant, and cemetery and agricultural appointments, signed MBTA license, and held off on a Lancaster water letter.
minutes.summary: The board heard a good FY17 financial close-out from the finance director, made several appointments, and spent a long stretch on the Architectural Preservation District Commission's draft guidelines, with residents raising cost and fairness concerns. It authorized the town manager to sign an MBTA license agreement and deferred a letter of support for a Lancaster MassWorks grant over water-permit worries. The APDC was asked to make one more pass at the guidelines.

what_happened.line: The Select Board asked the Architectural Preservation District Commission to make one more pass on its draft guidelines and send comments back to the board.
The board voted to authorize the town manager to sign an MBTA license and occupancy agreement.
The board deferred a letter of support for a Lancaster MassWorks grant until it hears from the Water District about the water withdrawal permit.
The board approved appointments to the Agricultural and Cemetery Commissions and a clock winder, and a common victualler license for Dragonfly Garden Cafe LLC.
The finance director reported FY17 collections slightly above estimate and spending just under budget; votes to ratify the building inspector and DPW assistant were not audible.

why_it_matters: The preservation district guidelines would set what property owners in the district must submit and follow for siding, windows and demolition, and residents raised cost and fairness concerns that the commission is now being asked to address.
The FY17 close-out shows revenue above estimate and spending under budget, which feeds the free cash figure that later budget and Town Meeting decisions draw on.
The deferred Lancaster grant letter depends on the water withdrawal permit, which bears on water supply and permitting.
watch_next: The commission's revised comments on the guidelines, due back to the board.
August 15 workshop on town buildings (not televised) and the August 22 regular meeting.
